messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER triggered -> embeds-prod 5xx spike. Pages sent to rotation at 03:12 UTC. Incident: https://redwood.incidents/INC-4521
Sam W: I'm primary right now. Flight check-in in ~30m, can cover until wheels up but overlap might be tight. Can someone swap to primary for the next ~5h? I can stay reachable for escalations if needed.
Priya N: I can take primary for the next 6h, stand up with you now. LMK hot actions.
Sam W: Thanks. Current mitigations in-flight: rolling restart of embeders + prefix KV cache flush. Runbook link: https://go/runbooks/embeds-outage (see "Immediate mitigation" section). Key commands: ```bash
# restart embedder deployment
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/api/v1/embeds/restart -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS'
# flush prefix cache
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/cache/flush?prefix=embed_
```
Marco D: FYI telemetry shows eu-west has the largest error bump. If restart doesn't help, fallback to 'embed-lite' model variant per runbook.
Priya N: Copy. @incidents-bot please record handoff intent: Sam -> Priya. Also tagging @Marco D as infra backup.
incidents-bot: HANDOFF NOTE: requested change of primary. Recording: primary pending transfer from Sam W to Priya N.
Alice Chen: Quick note — if you scale batch workers down, KV cache warmup might spike latency for enterprise customers. Heads-up to watch the latency panel.
Sam W: Adding a short checklist for handoff: 1) scale embeders +2 (kubectl -n production rollout restart deployment/embedder) 2) flush KV cache (POST /cache/flush?prefix=embed_) 3) monitor errors on /dashboards/embed-errors 4) escalate to infra if error rate >5% sustained for 10m
Priya N: Taking primary. I'll run restart now and monitor logs. @Marco D can you be infra backup during the rollout?
Marco D: Yup, I'm standing by. If restart fails, plan B is rollback to commit abc123 (ops-notes). I'll be ready to run rollback.
Sam W: Also linked customer-impact doc: https://go/incidents/4521/customers — customers currently affected listed there.
Priya N: Restart issued: ```bash
kubectl -n production rollout restart deploy/embedder
# tail logs
stern embedder -n production
``` Restart in progress, will report in 5m.
incidents-bot: METRIC UPDATE: error rate reduced from 8.3% -> 2.1% within 4m after restart. Monitoring continues.
Priya N: Looks much better now, errors dropping. I'll remain primary for the window and watch for any regressions. Sam, enjoy the flight :airplane:
Sam W: Thanks — handoff complete from my side. I updated the oncall calendar slot for the swap window.
Alice Chen: Thumbs up. @Priya N if things regress, follow rollback steps and notify legal/sales if SLA impact exceeds 30m.
Priya N: Will do. Closing note: left a brief post in the incident doc about the actions taken and the handoff.
Sam W: Thanks all, appreciate the quick swap and coverage.
